prevalence_baseline.description: Constant trivial baseline predicting validation base rate

canonical_empirical_prior_baseline.description: Prompt-only Bayesian lookup P(error | canonical_phone) computed from 2,399 Fold 1 train utterances (zero acoustic waveform features)

acoustic_neural_model_fold1.description: Multi-task frozen Wav2Vec2 + Cross-Attention + Binary MDD Head (best.pt, Epoch 6)

comparative_findings.conclusion: Acoustic-conditioned neural model significantly outperforms both empirical prompt prior and prevalence baselines, demonstrating authentic acoustic dependence without TextGrid timestamp dependency.
